config.name: hardware.discovery.concurrency
config.description: Number of concurrent hardware discovery threads for physical servers.

config.name: hardware.discovery.timeoutSec
config.description: Timeout in seconds for a single hardware discovery attempt on a physical server.

config.name: hardware.discovery.retryMax
config.description: Maximum number of hardware discovery retry attempts before giving up on a physical server.

config.name: serverPool.defaultCreationPolicy
config.description: Controls when the system creates the default ServerPool for a Zone. Valid values: OnClusterCreate, OnZoneCreate, Manual.

config.name: provision.timeout
config.description: Maximum seconds to wait for OS install completion (ping target IP via gateway).

config.name: provision.pingInterval
config.description: Interval seconds between gateway-agent ping attempts during OS install monitoring.

config.name: power.pingInterval
config.description: Interval seconds between out-of-band power-status checks for tracked PhysicalServers.

config.name: power.pingParallelismDegree
config.description: Maximum number of concurrent out-of-band power-status checks per ping cycle.
